statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail is low at 8% while Stress is extreme at 80%.
recommendation: Tail sits far below the 25% block threshold, so the deterministic mapping resolves to EA_ON. The extreme Stress reading describes the regime rather than the observed path: long-end Treasury yields closed at 52-week highs, Brent is above $101 on the unresolved US-Iran conflict around the Strait of Hormuz, and August PPI prints at 12:30 UTC on 10 September. Live overnight NQ futures show a tight two-sided range with no extension, which is the opposite of a no-retracement path. A narrow elevated-risk window is flagged from 12:25 to 14:15 UTC around the PPI release and the US cash open; outside it, conditions are described as orderly.
headline: Overnight NQ futures hold a tight two-sided 0.2% range after a modestly lower Nasdaq-100 close, with long-end yields steady near 52-week highs and Brent above $101
body:
The Nasdaq-100 closed the 9 September session at 29,421.55, down 0.29%, inside a 29,334.40-29,563.60 range of about 0.78%. In the current overnight hour, NQ futures trade at 29,464.75, up 0.05%, within a 29,416.25-29,480.25 band of roughly 0.22%, rotating two-sided with no observed extension, no failed retracements and no hold near a session extreme. That is the primary reason Tail stays low at 8%.

The stress channels are unchanged and sit outside the index path. Treasury par yields rose again on 9 September to 4.17% at 2 years, 4.83% at 10 years and 5.28% at 30 years, with the 10-year having tagged a 4.857% intraday 52-week high; overnight the 10-year is broadly flat near 4.84%. Reported drivers include oil-led inflation concern, heavy AI-related corporate issuance, and a Treasury buyback of longer-dated debt tripled to $6 billion. Crude remains firm with WTI near $96.6 and Brent near $101.4 after the US struck five Iranian tankers and Iran attacked ten ships near the Strait of Hormuz and a base in Jordan; the strait is closed, roughly 42 tankers were reported waiting to transit, and the IRGC has declared a new maritime restricted zone. VIX finished at 16.46, up 4.71%, still low in absolute terms. Delayed cross-asset context collected before this hour is consistent with the live picture of flat index futures, firmer crude and slightly lower Treasury futures, and is used only as supporting confirmation.

The next scheduled catalysts are August PPI, core PPI and initial jobless claims at 12:30 UTC, with consensus near +0.4% headline and +0.3% core, followed by August CPI on 11 September and the two-day FOMC meeting on 15-16 September. Those are checkpoints rather than observed structure: before the print, event importance and forecast dispersion inform Stress and Confidence, not Tail. Confidence of 88% reflects verified current futures, volatility, yield, crude, geopolitical and calendar evidence for this hour.

lookbackSummary: Twenty-three of the preceding 24 clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment; the 10:00-11:00 UTC slot on 9 September has none and is marked unavailable. Tail ran between 7% and 9% through the Asian and European overnight, peaked at 20% in the 12:00 UTC hour, the single yellow WATCH slot in the window, then decayed through the US cash session to 9% from 21:00 UTC onward as price discovery stayed orderly. Stress climbed from 73% to an 83% peak and settled at 81%, driven by rates and crude rather than index path damage. Confidence held in an 87-89% band throughout.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds Tail in an 8-12% band through the Asian and European overnight, where headline discontinuity from the Strait of Hormuz into thin liquidity, not trend persistence, is the dominant mechanism. Tail then steps up into the 12:30 UTC PPI window and peaks at 20%, mapping to WATCH, in the 13:00 UTC hour where post-release repricing overlaps the US cash open. It decays back toward the overnight baseline through the US afternoon, with a small lift into the power hour before the 20:00 UTC close. Stress stays extreme throughout, peaking at 86% across the event and cash-open hours, and Confidence declines from 88% to 77% as each slot moves further from verified live evidence.
